name: EduVaani ISL Sign Animations & Fingerspelling Dataset
standard: Indian Sign Language Research and Training Centre (ISLRTC) conventions

1.label: One (1)
1.description: Index finger extended upright, all other fingers curled.

2.label: Two (2)
2.description: Index and middle fingers extended together, other fingers curled.

3.label: Three (3)
3.description: Index, middle, and ring fingers extended, thumb holding pinky.

4.label: Four (4)
4.description: Four fingers extended (index through pinky), thumb tucked across palm.

5.label: Five (5)
5.description: All five fingers and thumb fully extended and spread apart.

6.label: Six (6)
6.description: Full open hand (5) plus opposite index finger extended — showing 5+1.

7.label: Seven (7)
7.description: Full open hand (5) plus opposite two fingers extended — showing 5+2.

8.label: Eight (8)
8.description: Full open hand (5) plus opposite three fingers extended — showing 5+3.

9.label: Nine (9)
9.description: Full open hand (5) plus opposite four fingers extended — showing 5+4.

10.label: Ten (10)
10.description: Both hands fully open with all fingers spread, held side by side.

11.label: Eleven (11)
11.description: Both open palms (10) briefly followed by upward flick of index finger.

12.label: Twelve (12)
12.description: Both open palms (10) followed by two fingers flicking upward.

13.label: Thirteen (13)
13.description: Both open palms (10) followed by three fingers flicking upward.

14.label: Fourteen (14)
14.description: Both open palms (10) followed by four fingers flicking upward.

15.label: Fifteen (15)
15.description: Both open palms (10) followed by open 5-hand flicking outward.

16.label: Sixteen (16)
16.description: Thumb flicking against index then pinky in ISL counting sequence.

17.label: Seventeen (17)
17.description: Thumb flicking against ring finger in ISL teen counting.

18.label: Eighteen (18)
18.description: Thumb flicking against middle finger in ISL teen counting.

19.label: Nineteen (19)
19.description: Thumb flicking against index finger in ISL teen counting.

20.label: Twenty (20)
20.description: Both hands forming '2' touching at wrists side-by-side.

namaste.label: Namaste
namaste.description: Both palms pressed flat together at the center of chest with a slight respectful nod.

hello.label: Hello
hello.description: Dominant flat hand touching brow/temple, waving outward away from face.

thank you.label: Thank You
thank you.description: Fingertips touch the chin, then move downward and outward toward the partner.

thanks.label: Thank You
thanks.description: Fingertips touch chin and extend outward warmly.

good.label: Good
good.description: Closed fist with upright thumb pushed forward confidently from chest.

bad.label: Bad
bad.description: Thumb turned downward with a decisive downward sweep.

morning.label: Morning
morning.description: Curved open hand rising above flat base forearm, symbolizing the rising sun.

night.label: Night
night.description: Dominant hand curves downward over horizontal base forearm like sunset.

yes.label: Yes
yes.description: Closed fist nodding up and down from the wrist like a head nod.

no.label: No
no.description: Index and middle fingers snap down onto thumb tip twice.

help.label: Help
help.description: Closed fist with thumb upright lifted upward by flat base palm.

please.label: Please
please.description: Flat palm rubbing in circular clockwise motion over chest.

english.label: English
english.description: Dominant hand clasps the non-dominant hand across the back twice in a handshake motion.

learn.label: Learn
learn.description: Fingertips draw knowledge from flat base palm upward to touch forehead.

india.label: India / Bharat
india.description: Thumb touches center of forehead gently (bindi mark position).

bharat.label: Bharat
bharat.description: Thumb touches center of forehead gently in respectful placement.

friend.label: Friend
friend.description: Index fingers of both hands hook together like links of friendship.

water.label: Water
water.description: Index finger in W-handshape or cupped hand taps center of lower lip twice.

food.label: Food / Eat
food.description: Fingertips brought together and tapped near the mouth twice.

eat.label: Eat
eat.description: Fingertips brought together and tapped near the mouth twice.

teacher.label: Teacher
teacher.description: Flat O-hands at temples move forward, opening slightly into flat palms.

student.label: Student
student.description: Sign for Learn (palm to head) followed by Person agentive sign.

school.label: School
school.description: Dominant flat hand claps twice gently across the horizontal palm of base hand.

name.label: Name
name.description: Extended index and middle fingers of right hand tap over left index and middle fingers twice.

what.label: What
what.description: Both open palms held upward and shaken side to side with questioning facial expression.

where.label: Where
where.description: Index finger extended upright, pointing and shaking side-to-side questioningly.

how.label: How
how.description: Curved hands with backs facing each other roll outward until palms face upward.

who.label: Who
who.description: Index finger circles in small loops near the mouth and chin.

when.label: When
when.description: Dominant index finger circles around the left wrist (representing a watch face).

why.label: Why
why.description: Index finger touches temple, then extends outward with questioning expression.

me.label: Me / I
me.description: Index finger points directly to center of own chest.

i.label: I / Me
i.description: Index finger points directly to center of own chest.

you.label: You
you.description: Index finger points forward toward the conversation partner.

your.label: Your
your.description: Open flat palm pushed gently forward toward conversation partner.

my.label: My / Mine
my.description: Open flat palm placed on chest with fingers spread.

we.label: We / Us
we.description: Index finger sweeps in arc from self outward encompassing all present.

they.label: They / Them
they.description: Open palm sweeps sideways to reference a group.

happy.label: Happy
happy.description: Both flat open palms brush upward against chest repeatedly with a cheerful smile.

sad.label: Sad
sad.description: Both flat open palms move downward along cheeks, mimicking tears falling.

angry.label: Angry
angry.description: Claw-shaped hands pulled upward from chest outward with tense expression.

scared.label: Scared / Afraid
scared.description: Both open palms rise rapidly from sides toward chest in protective flinch gesture.

love.label: Love
love.description: Both hands cross over chest and press against heart area warmly.

surprise.label: Surprise
surprise.description: Both fists pop open near eyes simultaneously with wide facial expression.

tired.label: Tired
tired.description: Both open hands placed on upper chest with fingers drooping downward, body slumping.

welcome.label: Welcome
welcome.description: Both open palms sweep inward and toward the body in an inviting arc.

sorry.label: Sorry
sorry.description: Closed fist circles on chest in apologetic rubbing motion.

goodbye.label: Goodbye
goodbye.description: Flat open hand waving side to side at chest level in parting gesture.

practice.label: Practice
practice.description: Dominant fist with A-hand shape rubs back and forth over base index finger.

mother.label: Mother
mother.description: Thumb of open hand taps chin gently twice.

father.label: Father
father.description: Thumb of open hand taps forehead gently twice.

sister.label: Sister
sister.description: Girl sign (thumb strokes chin) followed by Same sign (both index fingers tap together).

brother.label: Brother
brother.description: Boy sign (thumb taps forehead) followed by Same sign (both index fingers tap together).

baby.label: Baby / Child
baby.description: Both arms cradle an imaginary baby, rocking gently side to side.

family.label: Family
family.description: Both F-hands circle outward from center, forming a family circle.

grandfather.label: Grandfather
grandfather.description: Father sign (forehead tap) repeated with hand moving further from forehead indicating elder generation.

grandmother.label: Grandmother
grandmother.description: Mother sign (chin tap) repeated with hand moving further indicating elder generation.

husband.label: Husband
husband.description: Boy sign followed by Marriage sign (both hands clasp together).

wife.label: Wife
wife.description: Girl sign followed by Marriage sign (both hands clasp together).

one.label: One (1)
one.description: Index finger extended upright, all other fingers curled.

two.label: Two (2)
two.description: Index and middle fingers extended together, other fingers curled.

three.label: Three (3)
three.description: Index, middle, and ring fingers extended, thumb holding pinky.

four.label: Four (4)
four.description: Four fingers extended (index through pinky), thumb tucked across palm.

five.label: Five (5)
five.description: All five fingers and thumb fully extended and spread apart.

six.label: Six (6)
six.description: Full open hand (5) plus opposite index finger extended — showing 5+1.

seven.label: Seven (7)
seven.description: Full open hand (5) plus opposite two fingers extended — showing 5+2.

eight.label: Eight (8)
eight.description: Full open hand (5) plus opposite three fingers extended — showing 5+3.

nine.label: Nine (9)
nine.description: Full open hand (5) plus opposite four fingers extended — showing 5+4.

ten.label: Ten (10)
ten.description: Both hands fully open with all fingers spread, held side by side.

hundred.label: Hundred (100)
hundred.description: C-handshape moves rightward into flat palm indicating large quantity.

red.label: Red
red.description: Index finger traces down across the lips (pointing to lip color).

blue.label: Blue
blue.description: B-handshape shakes side to side at chest level.

green.label: Green
green.description: G-handshape shakes side to side at chest level.

yellow.label: Yellow
yellow.description: Y-handshape (thumb and pinky extended) shakes at side.

white.label: White
white.description: Open 5-hand at chest pulls outward while fingers come together into flat O, representing cleanliness.

black.label: Black
black.description: Index finger drawn across the forehead from one temple to the other.

milk.label: Milk
milk.description: Both hands squeeze alternately in milking motion.

tea.label: Tea
tea.description: Thumb and index finger dip into cupped non-dominant palm like dipping a tea bag.

rice.label: Rice
rice.description: Cupped hand scoops upward from flat palm, bringing food toward mouth.

bread.label: Bread / Roti
bread.description: Both flat palms pat alternately against each other as if shaping roti dough.

fruit.label: Fruit
fruit.description: F-handshape twists at the cheek, as if biting into a fruit.

drink.label: Drink
drink.description: C-handshape tilted toward mouth as if drinking from a cup.

sugar.label: Sugar / Sweet
sugar.description: Fingertips brush downward over chin twice, indicating something sweet tasted.

spicy.label: Spicy / Hot
spicy.description: Index finger taps mouth, then hand shakes as if burning.

house.label: House / Home
house.description: Both flat hands form a roof shape above the head with fingertips touching, then slide down to sides forming walls.

hospital.label: Hospital
hospital.description: H-handshape draws a cross on the upper arm (representing medical cross).

market.label: Market / Shop
market.description: Both flat O-hands swing outward at sides repeatedly as if displaying wares.

temple.label: Temple / Mandir
temple.description: Both hands form pointed steeple shape above head, fingertips meeting at top.

city.label: City / Town
city.description: Both hands form roof shapes repeatedly alternating, indicating many buildings.

village.label: Village
village.description: Small roof shape made with both hands at lower level, indicating modest dwelling.

car.label: Car
car.description: Both hands grip an imaginary steering wheel and turn side to side.

bus.label: Bus
bus.description: Both B-hands move forward together in large vehicle motion.

train.label: Train
train.description: Two fingers of dominant hand slide back and forth over two fingers of base hand like train on tracks.

airplane.label: Airplane / Flight
airplane.description: Index finger, pinky, and thumb extended (ILY handshape) moving upward through air.

bicycle.label: Bicycle
bicycle.description: Both fists rotate alternately in circular pedaling motion.

walk.label: Walk
walk.description: Both flat hands alternate in forward stepping motion on surface.

run.label: Run
run.description: Both L-hands alternate rapidly in running motion, faster than walk.

sit.label: Sit
sit.description: Two bent fingers (legs) hook over edge of flat base hand (seat).

stand.label: Stand
stand.description: Two extended fingers (legs) stand upright on flat base palm.

come.label: Come
come.description: Index finger beckons inward toward self in welcoming curl.

go.label: Go
go.description: Index finger points and sweeps forward and away from body.

give.label: Give
give.description: Both cupped hands move forward from body toward recipient.

take.label: Take / Get
take.description: Both open hands pull inward toward body, closing into fists (grasping).

see.label: See / Look
see.description: V-handshape (two fingers) points from eyes outward in looking direction.

hear.label: Hear / Listen
hear.description: Cupped hand placed near ear, turning slightly toward sound source.

speak.label: Speak / Talk
speak.description: Four fingers tap against thumb repeatedly near mouth like a beak opening and closing.

read.label: Read
read.description: V-handshape (eyes) scans across flat open non-dominant palm (page).

write.label: Write
write.description: Dominant hand mimics holding pen, writes across flat non-dominant palm.

play.label: Play
play.description: Both Y-hands (thumb and pinky spread) shake side to side playfully.

sleep.label: Sleep
sleep.description: Open hand draws down over face while eyes close, head tilts to rest on palm.

work.label: Work
work.description: Both S-hands (fists) tap top of one over the other repeatedly.

think.label: Think
think.description: Index finger taps or circles at the temple of the forehead.

know.label: Know / Knowledge
know.description: Fingertips tap side of forehead firmly indicating stored knowledge.

understand.label: Understand
understand.description: Index finger flicks upward from near temple, like a lightbulb turning on.

want.label: Want / Need
want.description: Both open claw-hands pull inward toward chest with intent expression.

like.label: Like
like.description: Thumb and middle finger start on chest then pull outward with a snap.

dont like.label: Don't Like / Dislike
dont like.description: Like sign reversed — hand on chest flicks outward and twists into downward thumb.

big.label: Big / Large
big.description: Both hands start close together, then spread apart widely showing large size.

small.label: Small / Little
small.description: Both flat hands held close together and press slightly inward indicating smallness.

hot.label: Hot (Temperature)
hot.description: Claw hand near mouth flips outward and away, as if spitting out hot food.

cold.label: Cold
cold.description: Both fists near chest shake/shiver as if trembling from cold.

rain.label: Rain
rain.description: Both open 5-hands move downward repeatedly, fingers wiggling like falling raindrops.

sun.label: Sun / Sunny
sun.description: C-handshape held high overhead, fingers opening outward like sun rays.

wind.label: Wind / Windy
wind.description: Both open hands sweep side to side in flowing wind motion.

cloud.label: Cloud
cloud.description: Both curved claw hands form cloud shapes moving across at eye level.

dog.label: Dog
dog.description: Dominant hand pats the thigh twice as if calling a dog.

cat.label: Cat
cat.description: Pinched thumb and index at both sides of mouth pull outward like whiskers.

bird.label: Bird
bird.description: Index and thumb open and close near mouth like a bird beak.

cow.label: Cow
cow.description: Y-handshape (thumb up, pinky extended) placed at temple representing horn.

fish.label: Fish
fish.description: Flat hand held vertically swims forward with side-to-side undulation.

elephant.label: Elephant
elephant.description: Arm extends from nose tracing curved trunk path downward and outward.

monkey.label: Monkey
monkey.description: Both curved hands scratch armpits alternately in playful monkey motion.

horse.label: Horse
horse.description: Both extended thumbs placed at temples wiggle forward like horse ears.

doctor.label: Doctor
doctor.description: Fingertips of dominant hand tap inside of opposite wrist (checking pulse).

police.label: Police
police.description: C-handshape taps upper arm where a badge would be displayed.

farmer.label: Farmer
farmer.description: Both hands mimic holding and swinging a plough or sickle.

cook.label: Cook / Chef
cook.description: Dominant hand stirs circular motion over flat base palm (stirring a pot).

driver.label: Driver
driver.description: Steering wheel motion followed by Person agentive sign.

today.label: Today
today.description: Both Y-hands drop sharply downward from chest level, emphasizing NOW.

tomorrow.label: Tomorrow
tomorrow.description: Thumb of A-hand placed on cheek, pivots forward from cheek.

yesterday.label: Yesterday
yesterday.description: Thumb of A-hand touches cheek, then moves backward over shoulder.

now.label: Now
now.description: Both Y-hands drop firmly downward simultaneously with emphasis.

later.label: Later / After
later.description: L-hand held upright, thumb forward, tilts forward indicating future.

before.label: Before / Earlier
before.description: Dominant flat hand held in front of base hand, pulls back toward body.

always.label: Always
always.description: Index finger traces a continuous circle in front of body.

again.label: Again / Repeat
again.description: Curved dominant hand flips over and taps into flat base palm.

same.label: Same
same.description: Both index fingers extended and brought together side by side, tapping together.

different.label: Different
different.description: Both index fingers crossed then pulled apart sharply in opposite directions.

many.label: Many / Lots
many.description: Both S-hands pop open into 5-hands rapidly, showing abundance.

few.label: Few / Little (quantity)
few.description: A-handshape with thumb slowly rising off curled index finger.

more.label: More
more.description: Both flat O-hands tap fingertips together repeatedly.

less.label: Less / Fewer
less.description: Dominant flat hand moves downward past horizontal base hand.

new.label: New
new.description: Curved dominant hand scoops through flat base palm, brushing forward like discovering something new.

old.label: Old
old.description: C-hand grabs imaginary beard at chin and pulls downward.

beautiful.label: Beautiful
beautiful.description: Open 5-hand circles face clockwise, closing into flat O at chin, indicating beauty radiating.

clean.label: Clean
clean.description: Dominant palm sweeps across flat base palm cleanly from wrist to fingertips.

dirty.label: Dirty
dirty.description: Open 5-hand placed under chin with fingers wiggling.

open.label: Open
open.description: Both B-hands with edges touching swing outward and apart like opening a book.

close.label: Close / Shut
close.description: Both B-hands swing inward from apart to edges meeting, like closing a book.

buy.label: Buy / Purchase
buy.description: Flat hand scoops from base palm and moves outward (money leaving hand).

sell.label: Sell
sell.description: Both flat O-hands angle outward from body repeatedly, offering goods.

money.label: Money
money.description: Flat O-hand taps into flat base palm twice (as if placing coins).

book.label: Book
book.description: Both palms open from closed position like pages of a book opening.

pen.label: Pen / Pencil
pen.description: Dominant hand mimics holding pen, tips touch flat palm then write.

exam.label: Exam / Test
exam.description: Both hands draw question mark shapes in air simultaneously.

class.label: Class / Classroom
class.description: Both C-hands circle from front to sides showing an enclosed room.

correct.label: Correct / Right
correct.description: Dominant index finger stacks on top of base index finger, both pointing forward.

wrong.label: Wrong / Incorrect
wrong.description: Y-handshape placed on palm facing upward then flicked outward.

stop.label: Stop
stop.description: Dominant flat hand chops down sharply onto horizontal base palm.

start.label: Start / Begin
start.description: Dominant index finger twists between index and middle fingers of base hand like turning a key.

finish.label: Finish / Complete
finish.description: Both 5-hands flip outward simultaneously with decisive motion.

wait.label: Wait
wait.description: Both open 5-hands held up with palms facing, fingers wiggling in place impatiently.

fast.label: Fast / Quick
fast.description: Both L-hands with index pointing forward snap into S-fists rapidly.

slow.label: Slow
slow.description: Dominant open hand slides slowly up the back of base forearm.

easy.label: Easy
easy.description: Curved fingers of dominant hand brush upward off base fingertips repeatedly.

difficult.label: Difficult / Hard
difficult.description: Both bent V-hands alternate moving up and down in bumpy motion.

important.label: Important
important.description: Both F-hands (index and thumb touching) rise from base palms to upright position.

true.label: True / Truth
true.description: Index finger moves forward from lips in straight line (what comes from mouth is straight/true).

false.label: False / Lie
false.description: Index finger slides across chin sideways (mouth saying something crooked).

safe.label: Safe / Safety
safe.description: Both S-hands cross at wrists then pull apart and outward, breaking free.

danger.label: Danger / Dangerous
danger.description: Dominant A-hand thrust upward sharply past base hand, representing threat rising.

happy birthday.label: Happy Birthday
happy birthday.description: Happy sign (chest brush up) + B-hand on forehead opening forward (birth/born), then Day sign.

good morning.label: Good Morning
good morning.description: Good sign (thumbs up) followed by Morning sign (sun rising over arm).

good night.label: Good Night
good night.description: Good sign (thumbs up) followed by Night sign (hand curving over arm).

how are you.label: How Are You?
how are you.description: How sign (hands roll outward) + You sign (point forward) with questioning expression.

i am fine.label: I Am Fine
i am fine.description: Me sign (point to self) + Good/Fine sign (thumb up touching chest then forward).

whats your name.label: What Is Your Name?
whats your name.description: You sign (point) + Name sign (H-fingers tap) + What sign (palms shrug). ISL SOV order: YOU NAME WHAT.

my name.label: My Name Is...
my name.description: Me sign (point to chest) + Name sign (H-fingers tap), then fingerspell name.

i love you.label: I Love You
i love you.description: ILY handshape: thumb, index finger, and pinky extended simultaneously while middle and ring curled.

excuse me.label: Excuse Me
excuse me.description: Fingertips of dominant hand brush along base palm from heel to fingertips twice gently.

i dont understand.label: I Don't Understand
i dont understand.description: Me sign + Understand sign (index near temple) reversed with flick away and head shake.

please help me.label: Please Help Me
please help me.description: Please sign (palm circle on chest) + Help sign (fist on palm lifted) + Me sign (point to self). ISL: ME HELP PLEASE.

where is.label: Where Is...?
where is.description: Index finger shakes side-to-side with questioning expression and raised eyebrows.

how much.label: How Much / Price?
how much.description: Curved hands roll outward (How) + both flat hands held up with questioning palms (quantity).

nice to meet you.label: Nice To Meet You
nice to meet you.description: Good sign (thumb up) + Meet sign (both index fingers approach and touch) + You sign (point forward).

head.label: Head
head.description: Flat hand taps the top of the head twice.

eye.label: Eye / Eyes
eye.description: Index finger points to own eye area.

ear.label: Ear
ear.description: Index finger points to own ear, or thumb and index finger pinch earlobe.

nose.label: Nose
nose.description: Index finger taps side of nose.

mouth.label: Mouth
mouth.description: Index finger circles around the mouth area.

hand.label: Hand
hand.description: Dominant flat hand taps the back of the base flat hand.

stomach.label: Stomach
stomach.description: Flat hand pats stomach area twice.

hungry.label: Hungry
hungry.description: C-hand slides downward from throat to stomach, indicating emptiness.

thirsty.label: Thirsty
thirsty.description: Index finger draws line down throat, indicating dry throat.

pain.label: Pain / Hurt
pain.description: Both index fingers point toward each other and twist in opposite directions near the body part that hurts.

medicine.label: Medicine
medicine.description: Middle finger of dominant hand circles in center of flat base palm (grinding medicine).

sick.label: Sick / Ill
sick.description: Middle finger of one hand touches forehead while middle finger of other touches stomach, both simultaneously.

bathroom.label: Bathroom / Toilet
bathroom.description: T-handshape shaken side to side at chest level.

telephone.label: Telephone / Phone
telephone.description: Y-hand (thumb and pinky spread) held near ear with thumb at ear and pinky at mouth.

computer.label: Computer
computer.description: Both hands mime typing on keyboard with fingers moving rapidly.

internet.label: Internet
internet.description: Both 5-hands with middle fingers bent, tap together at middle fingertips alternately.

sign language.label: Sign Language
sign language.description: Both index fingers alternate in circular motion outward (representing dialogue), then Language sign.

deaf.label: Deaf
deaf.description: Index finger touches ear then moves to touch closed lips (ear-mouth).

hearing.label: Hearing (Person)
hearing.description: Index finger circles near mouth indicating speaking ability.

together.label: Together
together.description: Both A-hands (fists with thumbs up) come together from apart and join at midline.

share.label: Share
share.description: Dominant flat hand slides back and forth across base hand edge, dividing.

try.label: Try / Attempt
try.description: Both T-hands push forward from chest with determination.

problem.label: Problem
problem.description: Both bent V-handshapes alternately twist near forehead, indicating tangled thought.

question.label: Question
question.description: Index finger draws question mark shape in the air with raised eyebrows.

answer.label: Answer / Reply
answer.description: Both index fingers start at mouth then flick outward simultaneously, sending reply.

teach.label: Teach
teach.description: Both flat O-hands at temples move forward and outward, sharing knowledge.

test.label: Test / Quiz
test.description: Both index fingers draw X shapes in air then open into 5-hands (crossing questions).

holiday.label: Holiday / Vacation
holiday.description: Both 5-hands at armpits wiggle thumbs outward (relaxing, not working).

festival.label: Festival
festival.description: Both 5-hands rise upward with wiggling fingers like celebratory fireworks.

diwali.label: Diwali
diwali.description: Both cupped hands form small diya/lamp shapes, thumbs flickering upward like flames.

flag.label: Flag
flag.description: One hand holds imaginary pole upright, other flat hand waves beside it.

country.label: Country / Nation
country.description: Y-handshape circles near dominant shoulder in forward direction.

world.label: World
world.description: Both W-hands circle around each other in globe-like orbit.

peace.label: Peace
peace.description: Both flat palms face down from chest level and press slowly downward together, creating calm.

respect.label: Respect
respect.description: Flat hand touches forehead and curves outward in respectful salute.

pray.label: Pray / Prayer
pray.description: Both palms pressed together in Namaste position, then hands move slightly up and down.

nature.label: Nature / Environment
nature.description: Dominant 5-hand rises through base C-hand like a plant growing, fingers spreading open.

tree.label: Tree
tree.description: Dominant forearm stands upright on flat base palm (trunk on ground), 5-hand spreads open on top (branches).

flower.label: Flower
flower.description: Flat O-hand touches one side of nose, then the other, as if smelling a flower.

river.label: River
river.description: Both 5-hands with palms down ripple forward in flowing water motion.

mountain.label: Mountain
mountain.description: Both flat hands rise from sides and meet at peak above head, forming mountain shape.

eleven.label: Eleven (11)
eleven.description: Both open palms (10) briefly followed by upward flick of index finger (10+1).

twelve.label: Twelve (12)
twelve.description: Both open palms (10) followed by two fingers flicking upward (10+2).

thirteen.label: Thirteen (13)
thirteen.description: Both open palms (10) followed by three fingers flicking upward (10+3).

fourteen.label: Fourteen (14)
fourteen.description: Both open palms (10) followed by four fingers flicking upward (10+4).

fifteen.label: Fifteen (15)
fifteen.description: Both open palms (10) followed by open 5-hand flicking outward (10+5).

sixteen.label: Sixteen (16)
sixteen.description: Dominant thumb flicking against index then pinky, showing 10+6 in ISL sequence.

seventeen.label: Seventeen (17)
seventeen.description: Dominant thumb flicking against ring finger in standard ISL teen counting.

eighteen.label: Eighteen (18)
eighteen.description: Dominant thumb flicking against middle finger in ISL teen counting.

nineteen.label: Nineteen (19)
nineteen.description: Dominant thumb flicking against index finger in ISL teen counting.

twenty.label: Twenty (20)
twenty.description: Both hands forming '2' (index and middle extended) touching at wrists side-by-side.

orange.label: Orange
orange.description: C-hand squeezing gently near chin as if squeezing an orange fruit.

pink.label: Pink
pink.description: Index finger stroking gently downward across the lower lip or cheek.

purple.label: Purple
purple.description: P-handshape shaken gently in neutral chest space.

brown.label: Brown
brown.description: B-handshape sliding downward along the side of the cheek.

daughter.label: Daughter
daughter.description: Girl sign (index touching earlobe) followed by baby rocking gesture in cradle posture.

son.label: Son
son.description: Boy sign (hand brushing across mustache line) followed by baby rocking gesture.

aunt.label: Aunt / Chachi
aunt.description: Open hand touching side of forehead, then gesturing toward side with respectful bow.

uncle.label: Uncle / Chacha
uncle.description: Index and thumb curling at upper lip (mustache) followed by respectful two-handed nod.

leg.label: Leg
leg.description: Open flat hand pointing and lightly tapping thigh or upper leg.

foot.label: Foot
foot.description: Flat palm tapping downward indicating ground base foot.

arm.label: Arm
arm.description: One hand stroking smoothly along the forearm of the opposite arm.

teeth.label: Teeth
teeth.description: Curved index finger tapping or gliding across exposed front teeth.

heart.label: Heart
heart.description: Both hands trace heart silhouette over the left chest cavity.

coffee.label: Coffee
coffee.description: Top fist rotating circularly over bottom fist as if turning an old coffee grinder.

roti.label: Roti / Chapati
roti.description: Both palms clapping alternately in rhythmic circular patting motion rolling out dough.

dal.label: Dal / Lentils
dal.description: Cupped hand holding imaginary bowl while other hand spoons liquid toward mouth.

apple.label: Apple
apple.description: Knuckle of curved index finger twisting against cheek with slight smile.

banana.label: Banana
banana.description: Base upright index represents banana; dominant hand peels downward strips.

proud.label: Proud
proud.description: Thumb of A-hand glides straight upward along sternum/center of chest with chin raised.

excited.label: Excited
excited.description: Both open hands with middle fingers bent alternating upward circular sweeps over chest.

calm.label: Calm / Peaceful
calm.description: Both open palms facing downward press gently downward simultaneously with relaxed breathing.

worried.label: Worried
worried.description: Both open palms circling near forehead with furrowed eyebrows and concerned facial gloss.

day.label: Day
day.description: Dominant arm arcs like sun moving across horizontal horizon base forearm.

week.label: Week
week.description: Index finger glides across flat non-dominant palm from heel to fingertips.

month.label: Month
month.description: Dominant index slides down the back of vertical non-dominant index finger.

year.label: Year
year.description: Dominant fist revolves fully around stationary base fist like Earth orbiting Sun.

minute.label: Minute
minute.description: Index finger on base palm ticks forward once like a clock minute hand.

hour.label: Hour
hour.description: Index finger makes full circular revolution on base flat palm like clock hand.

evening.label: Evening
evening.description: Curved dominant hand arcs downward over horizontal base wrist simulating sunset.

afternoon.label: Afternoon
afternoon.description: Dominant forearm angled at 45 degrees over horizontal base arm representing midday sun.

boat.label: Boat / Ship
boat.description: Both cupped hands join at pinkies and glide forward with gentle wave motion.

motorcycle.label: Motorcycle / Bike
motorcycle.description: Both fists holding imaginary handlebars, right wrist twisting throttle twice.

auto.label: Auto Rickshaw
auto.description: Two hands pulling starting lever upward then steering three-wheeler handlebar.

metro.label: Metro / Sub-Train
metro.description: Flat dominant hand gliding swiftly underneath flat horizontal base hand simulating subway.

nurse.label: Nurse
nurse.description: Index and middle fingers tap wrist pulse point, followed by uniform cross gesture.

soldier.label: Soldier / Jawan
soldier.description: Both fists held at shoulder holding rifle, followed by crisp forehead salute.

shopkeeper.label: Shopkeeper
shopkeeper.description: Store sign (hands flipping forward at chest) followed by person indicator.

engineer.label: Engineer
engineer.description: Y-hands interlocking thumb and pinky tips twisting back and forth like gears.

warm.label: Warm
warm.description: Loose fist at mouth opening outward gently as if blowing warm air on hands.

storm.label: Storm / Thunder
storm.description: Both claw hands twisting vigorously with zigzag lightning gesture downward.

winter.label: Winter
winter.description: Both fists held at chest shivering side to side simulating cold weather.

summer.label: Summer
summer.description: Index finger wiping sweat across forehead from left to right.

lion.label: Lion / Sher
lion.description: Both clawed hands rake backward over head and shoulders depicting magnificent mane.

tiger.label: Tiger / Baagh
tiger.description: Spread fingers drawing tiger stripes across cheeks outward from nose.

snake.label: Snake / Saanp
snake.description: Bent two fingers (fangs) slithering forward with undulating wave motion.

rabbit.label: Rabbit / Khargosh
rabbit.description: U-handshapes placed at sides of head, fingers twitching back twice like rabbit ears.

goat.label: Goat / Bakri
goat.description: Hand pulling imaginary goatee at chin followed by two fingers curled backward at temple as horns.

wash.label: Wash
wash.description: Both fists rubbing against each other in circular scrubbing motion.

dance.label: Dance
dance.description: Inverted V-fingers (legs) swinging back and forth gracefully over flat base palm.

sing.label: Sing
sing.description: Dominant hand arcing out from mouth with graceful melodic waves.

swim.label: Swim
swim.description: Both flat hands breaststroking forward outward in swimming strokes.

call.label: Call / Phone
call.description: Y-hand held to ear and mouth in telephone sign.

remember.label: Remember
remember.description: Thumb of dominant A-hand touches forehead then presses downward onto base thumb nail.

forget.label: Forget
forget.description: Open hand wiping across forehead into loose fist as if wiping thought away.

take care.label: Take Care
take care.description: Both K-hands crossed at wrists tapping gently twice in protective posture.

congratulations.label: Congratulations / Badhai
congratulations.description: Clasping both hands together over right and left shoulders with celebratory smile.

no problem.label: No Problem
no problem.description: Both open palms shaking gently side to side with reassuring head shake.

see you.label: See You Later
see you.description: V-hand from eye (see) followed by L-hand twisting forward (later).

A.description: Left hand open flat pointing up; right index finger touches left thumb tip (first vowel in ISL A-E-I-O-U sequence).

B.description: Both hands form circles with thumbs and index fingers, joined side-by-side to form letter B.

C.description: Hand curved into a clear semi-circular C arc held in space.

D.description: Left index points upright (stem of D); right hand C-shape touches left index tip and base.

E.description: Left hand open flat; right index touches the tip of left index finger (second vowel in ISL).

F.description: Left index and middle extended together; right index and middle cross across them like letter F.

G.description: Both hands form fists; right fist placed directly on top of left fist.

H.description: Left flat hand horizontal; right flat hand sweeps across left palm from wrist to fingertips.

I.description: Left hand open flat; right index touches tip of left middle finger (third vowel in ISL).

J.description: Right index traces letter J path downwards from left middle fingertip across left palm.

K.description: Left index upright; right index hooked into right angle against left index knuckle.

L.description: Right hand thumb and index extended at 90 degrees forming letter L.

M.description: Right hand three middle fingers (index, middle, ring) placed flat across left palm (three legs of M).

N.description: Right hand two fingers (index, middle) placed across left palm (two legs of N).

O.description: Left hand open flat; right index touches tip of left ring finger (fourth vowel in ISL).

P.description: Left index upright; right hand forms circle with thumb & index touching left index tip.

Q.description: Left hand forms horizontal circle (O); right index placed into circle to form tail of Q.

R.description: Right index hooked over the top of left index finger.

S.description: Both pinky fingers hooked together like interlocking S links.

T.description: Left index upright; right index placed horizontally across the top forming letter T.

U.description: Left hand open flat; right index touches tip of left pinky finger (fifth vowel in ISL).

V.description: Right index and middle fingers spread apart in clear V shape.

W.description: Fingers of both open hands interlocked with palms facing inward, forming W peaks.

X.description: Both index fingers crossed at right angles to form letter X.

Y.description: Left thumb and index spread in L; right index placed into vertex forming letter Y.

Z.description: Right index touches left palm, forming Z zig-zag motion across the palm.
